title: The New York Times Reportedly Eyying Letterboxd Acquisition
excerpt: The New York Times Company is reportedly in talks to acquire the social film-watching platform Letterboxd for $330 million.
body_html:
The New York Times Company is reportedly pursuing an acquisition of the film-sharing and social networking platform Letterboxd for a price of $330 million.

Representatives for The New York Times Company declined to comment when asked about the reported buyout discussions.
